'''Jigoba''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]],<ref name="CSWE" /> and controlled an organization similar in size to that of [[Talon Karrde]]. While in the employ of Jigoba's organization outside of the Corporate Sector, [[Ploovo Two-For-One/Legends|Ploovo Two-For-One]] was educated in the finer points of usury. Ploovo made off with whatever he could of Jigoba's possessions and fled to the Corporate Sector when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] moved in on Jigoba's turf after Jigoba died.<ref name="HSCSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
